data.historical_saturation_exception: Only 54 N8K8 training contexts; historical reuse audited explicitly

bootstrap.unit: Complete anchor family, stratified by K; same draws across arms and fixed seeds
bootstrap.inference_scope: Conditional example uncertainty for these two fitted seeds; not uncertainty over training seeds

interpretation.treatment: Whole parallel isolated local computation plus learned native SUM fusion versus same-parameter joint hidden adaptation
interpretation.native_first_token_nll: Raw full-vocabulary first-token NLL; unseen multi-digit values are not scored as whole-answer likelihood
interpretation.primary_exact: Strict nonnegative integer parse equals gold AND native EOS completed within four tokens
interpretation.parsed_count_correct: Secondary parse-only metric includes unfinished but numerically correct outputs
interpretation.data_change: Balanced q x N x K training differs from V1-V6; only the new matched joint control is a primary comparator
interpretation.numerical_scope: Known native quantized batching/cache differences remain descriptive; original failed runtime/numerical artifacts are not erased
interpretation.bootstrap: Fixed-seed paired family intervals; pooled estimates cannot rescue a failed per-seed criterion
